# 6-Month Spanish Path from A1 to B1

A steady **5 hours/week** can get you from beginner to solid intermediate if you keep the focus tight: **travel speaking, pronunciation, and high-frequency grammar**. This plan is built around short daily exposure, weekly speaking, and regular review so you keep moving without overload.

## Weekly Milestone Roadmap

| Week | Focus | Key sessions | Milestone |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sound system + greetings | Pronunciation app drills; basic phrases; 10-minute shadowing | Introduce yourself, greet, spell your name |
| 2 | Numbers, time, and travel basics | Podcast listening; airport/hotel vocabulary; mini speaking prompts | Ask for time, prices, and simple directions |
| 3 | Present tense: ser/estar/hay | Grammar app lesson; sentence building; speaking practice | Describe people, places, and what exists |
| 4 | Present tense: regular verbs | Daily verb drills; travel situations; short self-talk | Say what you do, need, want, and like |
| 5 | Articles, gender, plurals | Grammar review; vocab sorting; pronunciation cleanup | Make basic noun phrases correctly |
| 6 | Food and ordering | Restaurant dialogues; listening; role-play | Order food and ask about the menu |
| 7 | Question words + survival travel | Podcast + Q&A practice; speaking prompts | Ask where, when, how much, and how |
| 8 | Past intro: preterite of common verbs | Simple story practice; review deck; speaking | Describe what you did yesterday |
| 9 | Present continuous + routine talk | Listening; daily routine narration; pronunciation | Explain what you are doing now |
| 10 | Travel logistics | Booking, transport, check-in vocabulary | Handle buses, trains, hotels, and tickets |
| 11 | Direct object pronouns intro | Short grammar drills; substitution practice | Replace repeated nouns in simple sentences |
| 12 | Review + checkpoint | Mixed quiz; speaking recap; error review | Reach stable A1 and early A2 control |
| 13 | Reflexive verbs + daily life | App practice; speaking on routines; shadowing | Talk about getting ready, waking up, habits |
| 14 | Comparisons + preferences | Travel comparisons; opinion sentences | Compare places, food, and options |
| 15 | Imperfect intro for descriptions | Listening; story descriptions; guided speaking | Describe places and routines in the past |
| 16 | Pronunciation focus block | Stress, vowel clarity, linked speech | Improve clarity and reduce hesitation |
| 17 | Travel problem-solving | Missed train, wrong turn, hotel issue role-plays | Explain a problem and ask for help |
| 18 | Future with ir a + plans | Planning phrases; trip discussion | Say where you are going and why |
| 19 | Object pronouns + common connectors | Sentence expansion; conversation practice | Speak more naturally and avoid repetition |
| 20 | Listening stretch | Podcast summaries; slow native audio | Catch the main idea of short travel clips |
| 21 | B1 grammar consolidation | Mixed tense review; guided writing | Use present, preterite, imperfect with more control |
| 22 | Opinion and justification | Speaking on destinations, food, activities | Give simple reasons and preferences |
| 23 | Conversation endurance | 15-minute speaking sessions; follow-up questions | Keep a short conversation going |
| 24 | Final review and B1 readiness | Full review cycle; mock travel role-play | Manage common travel conversations with confidence |

## Weekly Study Structure and Review System

| Weekly block | Time | What to do | Best tool type |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Pronunciation | 45 min | Shadow 1 short audio, repeat tricky sounds, record yourself | App + podcast |
| Grammar | 75 min | Learn 1 small grammar point and make 10–15 sentences | App |
| Travel vocabulary | 45 min | Learn words in a real scenario: hotel, airport, restaurant, transport | App + flashcards |
| Listening | 60 min | Listen to a short podcast episode twice; note key phrases | Podcast |
| Speaking practice | 75 min | Self-talk, partner exchange, or tutor conversation | Speaking app / tutor |
| Review + test | 20 min | Spaced repetition, error log, quick recap quiz | Flashcards |

### Review system
- **Daily:** 10–15 minutes of spaced repetition for words, phrases, and example sentences.
- **Weekly:** Review the last 2 weeks before learning new material.
- **Monthly:** Do one speaking checkpoint and one mixed grammar/listening checkpoint.
- **Error log:** Keep a short list of recurring mistakes; review it every Friday.
- **Rule:** If you miss a week, do not skip ahead—use the next review block to catch up.

## Recommended Tool Mix

- **Apps:** Duolingo, Busuu, Babbel, or Memrise for structure and vocabulary.
- **Pronunciation:** Forvo, SpanishDict audio, and shadowing with slow native clips.
- **Podcasts:** Coffee Break Spanish, Notes in Spanish, or SpanishPod101 beginner lessons.
- **Speaking practice:** italki, Tandem, HelloTalk, or a language exchange partner.
- **Flashcards:** Anki or Quizlet for travel phrases and high-frequency grammar patterns.
